Unique decorations
you won't find anywhere else.

At Čarokavárna we take pride in originality and uniqueness. Our decorations aren't just ordinary interior accessories. They are one-of-a-kind custom-made pieces, with attention to every detail. Many of them are even life-sized, so you can enjoy the magical world quite literally within arm's reach.

We keep improving Čarokavárna and taking it further. Since it opened, the interior has gone through a big transformation and has gradually filled up with all kinds of decorations, each with its own soul and story.

A wizard's menu
you conjure up yourself.

Here at Čarokavárna we can turn ordinary things into something extraordinary.

That's why you won't get just any old menu. Ours is magical, and it carefully guards its contents from the eyes of all muggles.

A true wizard has to conjure up their own menu! Just take our special magic wand in your hand and reveal the secrets hidden on its pages.

And believe us — truly anyone can master this spell! ✨

Follow the magic wand, which reveals what the naked eye cannot see. Follow the magic wand — it reveals what the menu hides.

Frequently asked
questions

Can children come too?

Of course! ❤️ Čarokavárna is open to little and grown-up wizards alike, and there's no age limit. You're welcome to come with a pram, too.

Can I buy a gift voucher?

Yes! At Čarokavárna we offer gift vouchers worth 500 CZK and 1,000 CZK, depending on current availability.

Vouchers can only be bought in person, right at Čarokavárna. Unfortunately, we don't sell or send vouchers online.

Are dogs allowed?

Unfortunately not. Dogs aren't allowed anywhere in the arcade where Čarokavárna is located. Thank you for understanding.

Are the wizard cloaks and other props free to borrow?

Yes! All the props we lend out are completely free. Whether it's wizard cloaks, hats, masks, wands or board games, you can try everything during your visit at no charge.

Is there an entrance fee?

No, there's no entrance fee. You only pay for what you order.

Do I need a reservation?

On weekends, public holidays and during school holidays we strongly recommend booking, as we're often full.

On weekdays outside holidays you usually don't need a reservation, but if you want to be sure of a table, we recommend booking one.

Can we come without a reservation?

Of course! We keep four tables reserved for guests without a booking.

On weekends, public holidays and during school holidays they may all be taken, though. In that case, just wait a little while until one frees up.

On weekdays outside holidays you'll usually get in without a reservation and without waiting.

How long can I book a table for?

A standard reservation lasts one hour. If you'd like to enjoy the magical atmosphere longer, you can also book the next time slot.

Do you have gluten-free and lactose-free desserts?

Yes, we do! Fresh gluten-free and lactose-free desserts are delivered every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday.

Sometimes a few are left for the following day, but on those days you can be most sure to find them.

Do you decorate tables for birthdays?

Unfortunately, we can't provide birthday table decorations due to capacity reasons.

But we're happy to make your birthday a little more special! We can put a birthday candle in a dessert of your choice and light it for you.
